errors.description: The drawn pocket opening runs essentially PARALLEL to the outseam, holding a constant ~3.2 cm offset from it down its whole length. The rendered opening converges instead: about 4.4 cm from the outseam at the waistband, closing to about 1.7 cm at the bar tack.
errors.expected: opening held at a constant ~3.2 cm from the side seam over its full length
errors.actual: opening starting ~4.4 cm in and converging to ~1.7 cm at the bottom
errors.correction: hold the opening parallel to the outseam at a constant 3.2 cm offset rather than letting it run into the side seam

errors.description: Mid-grey cloth against a light-grey seamless gives weak subject-to-background separation along the frame-left edge, and the pocket reads as a fine pressed seam rather than an obvious opening, so it takes a beat longer than one second to identify.
errors.expected: clear separation between garment and background, opening readable instantly
errors.actual: grey-on-grey at the left edge; the opening is a fine pressed seam with a bar tack
errors.correction: darker cloth or a lighter background would lift the separation; a fractionally open pocket mouth would make the opening read faster

lockedFeatures: orientation: three-quarter front of the trouser hip, waistband to mid-thigh - CORRECT
ONE front pocket opening running from the waistband down the hip toward the outseam, terminating in a bar tack - CORRECT
opening length about 17 cm - CORRECT for a tailored front pocket
opening set in from the outseam rather than cut on the side seam - CORRECT in kind, offset converges (see errors)
opening edge pressed flat and closed, edge-stitched, no gaping - CORRECT
plain waistband with belt loops, no side adjusters - CORRECT, matches the drawn waistband and loops
pressed front crease running down the leg - CORRECT
flat front, no pleats - CORRECT, the drawing shows none
NO back welt pocket rendered - CORRECT; the horizontal welt in the drawing is a back pocket belonging to a different option and was correctly excluded
shirt tucked at the waistband, no belt, no props, no hands - CORRECT
fine wool trouser cloth with visible weave, seamless light-grey studio background - CORRECT
zero text, numbers, arrows, leader lines, red guide marks or callouts - CORRECT; the drawing carries no red marks and none were invented
notes: Attempt 1. The drawing was measured rather than eyeballed: its pocket line sits a constant ~55 px from the outseam on a hip drawn ~1020 px wide, which scales to the specified 3.2 cm, so the option is a near-parallel opening set 3.2 cm in from the side seam, not a steeply raked jeans-style slant. The render reproduces the opening, its ~17 cm length, its bar tack, the pressed closed edge, the plain looped waistband, the crease and the flat front, and correctly leaves out the back welt pocket that appears elsewhere in the same drawing. Two minor findings logged: the opening converges toward the outseam instead of holding parallel, and grey-on-grey tonality softens the read. Neither changes which option the photograph depicts.
